# Speech fixture

`jfk.wav` is the 11-second speech sample distributed with [whisper.cpp](https://github.com/ggml-org/whisper.cpp/blob/master/samples/jfk.wav) under the MIT licence (SHA-256 `59dfb9a4acb36fe2a2affc14bacbee2920ff435cb13cc314a08c13f66ba7860e`). The optional native transcription test uses it as a public, reproducible opening phrase.
